editorialNote.en: Scenario analysis, not a price target or recommendation. Multiples are Afflatus fair-value bands for comparing business models; they are not live market quotes.
editorialNote.zh: 情景分析，不是目标价或投资建议。估值倍数是 Afflatus 用来比较商业模式的合理区间，并非实时行情。

route.zh: 开放权重 · 带商业门槛

headline.en: The frontier did not become free. It became contestable.
headline.zh: 前沿能力没有变成免费品，但已经变得可争夺。

summary.en: K3 combines a 2.8T-parameter MoE, 104B active parameters, native vision, one-million-token context and quantization-aware deployment. Its strongest signal is not parameter count: it is near-frontier agentic and coding work at a lower per-task cost, delivered as downloadable weights.
summary.zh: K3 将 2.8 万亿参数 MoE、1040 亿激活参数、原生视觉、百万上下文与量化感知部署结合起来。真正重要的不是参数规模，而是以更低的单任务成本提供接近前沿的代理与编程能力，并交付可下载权重。

label.zh: 相对 K2 扩展效率

title.en: Write, correct and decay a fixed state
title.zh: 在固定状态中写入、纠错与衰减

official.en: K3 uses 69 KDA layers with a fixed-size recurrent state and data-dependent channel-wise decay. This flattens the state cost as token count grows, but the state is finite and can suffer interference.
official.zh: K3 使用 69 层 KDA，以固定大小的递归状态和数据依赖的逐通道衰减工作。Token 增长时状态成本趋于平坦，但容量仍有限，也会发生信息干扰。

thread.en: The Waterloo thread's write / erase / fade language is a useful teaching metaphor for delta correction and decay, not Moonshot's formal terminology and not lossless memory.
thread.zh: Waterloo 推文用“写入／擦除／褪色”解释 Delta 纠错与衰减，教学上很直观，但这不是月之暗面的正式术语，更不代表无损记忆。

investment.en: Long-context cache grows more slowly; HBM demand does not disappear because model weights and the MLA layers still have to reside and serve.
investment.zh: 长上下文缓存斜率下降，但模型权重与 MLA 层仍需驻留和服务，因此 HBM 需求并未消失。

title.en: Full attention becomes a correction layer
title.zh: 全注意力变成周期纠错层

official.en: The 93-layer stack interleaves 69 KDA and 24 gated-MLA layers, broadly three KDA layers followed by one MLA layer. MLA periodically restores global softmax retrieval over compressed latent KV history.
official.zh: 93 层堆栈由 69 层 KDA 与 24 层门控 MLA 交错构成，大致每三层 KDA 接一层 MLA。MLA 周期性地对压缩后的 latent KV 历史执行全局 Softmax 检索。

thread.en: Calling this exact retrieval is only relative to the latent history that MLA retained. It cannot reconstruct original information that was never stored or was compressed away.
thread.zh: 所谓“精确检索”只能相对于 MLA 保留的 latent 历史成立；未被保存或压缩时丢失的原始信息，无法凭空恢复。

investment.en: Attention is not eliminated. Memory bandwidth, cache policy and serving software remain investable bottlenecks, especially at one million tokens.
investment.zh: 注意力并未被消灭。尤其在百万 Token 场景，内存带宽、缓存策略与服务软件仍是可投资的关键瓶颈。

title.zh: AttnRes 回取更早层的表征

official.en: Block AttnRes uses learned pseudo-queries to weight the embedding and earlier block outputs. K3 groups roughly 12 layers per block, creating about eight depth checkpoints without retaining every layer output.
official.zh: Block AttnRes 通过可学习的伪查询，为嵌入和更早区块输出分配权重。K3 大约每 12 层组成一个区块，形成约八个深度检查点，而不必保留每一层输出。

thread.en: This is retrieval across network depth, not retrieval across the token timeline. Performance ratios quoted in explanatory threads stay commentary unless the official report defines the same setup.
thread.zh: 它检索的是网络深度，不是 Token 时间轴。解释性推文中的性能倍数，除非官方报告给出同一测试设置，否则仍属于作者评论。

investment.en: The design attacks representation dilution, while moving pressure into activation staging, block communication and runtime orchestration.
investment.zh: 该设计缓解深层表征稀释，却把压力转移到激活暂存、区块通信与运行时编排。

title.en: Sparse compute still needs a dense system
title.zh: 稀疏计算仍需要密集系统

official.en: Stable LatentMoE routes 16 of 896 experts per token, plus shared experts, inside a compressed latent path. Total capacity is 2.8T parameters while active parameters are 104B.
official.zh: Stable LatentMoE 在压缩潜空间路径中为每个 Token 路由 896 个专家中的 16 个，并配有共享专家。总容量为 2.8 万亿参数，激活参数为 1040 亿。

thread.en: The thread correctly emphasizes sparsity, but any comparison that substitutes a much smaller active-parameter figure conflicts with the official 104B figure and is excluded here.
thread.zh: 推文正确强调了稀疏性，但若用显著更小的激活参数类比，就与官方 1040 亿数字冲突；本页不采用这类数字。

investment.en: Expert weights still need HBM residency and cross-device routing still needs high-speed all-to-all fabric. MoE shifts value toward memory, interconnect and scheduling rather than removing it.
investment.zh: 专家权重仍需驻留 HBM，跨设备路由仍依赖高速 All-to-All 互连。MoE 不是消灭基础设施价值，而是把价值推向内存、互连与调度。

title.zh: 同一套架构，三层证据必须分开

body.en: Official Moonshot materials establish KDA, gated MLA, Block AttnRes, Stable LatentMoE and the 2.8T / 104B configuration. The Waterloo thread supplies an engineer's explanatory frame. Afflatus then maps the verified mechanisms to memory, interconnect and serving economics. Metaphors and vendor-measured figures are not promoted into independent facts.
body.zh: 月之暗面官方材料确认 KDA、门控 MLA、Block AttnRes、Stable LatentMoE 与 2.8T／104B 配置；Waterloo 推文提供工程师的解释框架；Afflatus 再把已核验机制映射到内存、互连和服务经济性。比喻与厂商测试数字不会被抬升为独立事实。

note.en: Four points behind Fable at 38% of its per-task cost.
note.zh: 比 Fable 低 4 分，单任务成本约为其 38%。

note.en: US$2.03 per task; roughly half GPT-5.6 and about one-tenth of Claude at maximum effort.
note.zh: 每任务 2.03 美元；约为 GPT-5.6 的一半、Claude 最大努力档的十分之一。

note.en: Within 50 Elo of GPT-5.6 and about 2.6× cheaper than Fable.
note.zh: 距 GPT-5.6 不到 50 Elo，且比 Fable 便宜约 2.6 倍。

note.en: Second-best result in the report at roughly half Fable's cost.
note.zh: 报告中排名第二，成本约为 Fable 的一半。

status.en: 31 JUL 2026 · FLASH-0731 OFFICIAL RELEASE · API PUBLIC BETA
status.zh: 2026 年 7 月 31 日 · FLASH-0731 正式版 · API 公测

headline.en: Low price is a live capacity experiment, not a permanent free lunch
headline.zh: 低价是一场正在运行的容量实验，不是永久免费的午餐

assessment.en: DeepSeek V4 is best understood as a capacity-and-pricing experiment during a low-cost Preview phase. V4-Flash-0731 pairs 284B / 13B parameters, a 1M context window and 2,500 account-level concurrency for throughput-heavy workloads; V4-Pro pairs 1.6T / 49B with 500 concurrency for heavier reasoning. The Flash 0731 API is in public beta, while the 31 July notice kept the official Pro release pending.
assessment.zh: DeepSeek V4 更适合被理解为低价 Preview 阶段的容量—价格实验。V4-Flash-0731 以 2840 亿／130 亿参数、100 万上下文和每账户 2500 并发承接高吞吐任务；V4-Pro 以 1.6 万亿／490 亿参数和 500 并发覆盖更重推理。Flash 0731 API 已进入公测，而 7 月 31 日公告仍把 Pro 正式版列为待发布。

availability.en: OpenAI + Anthropic APIs; Responses API available
availability.zh: 支持 OpenAI 与 Anthropic API；Responses API 已可用

availability.en: OpenAI + Anthropic APIs; Responses API was still listed as planned
availability.zh: 支持 OpenAI 与 Anthropic API；Responses API 在官方页仍标为计划中

title.zh: 并发按账户统一计算

body.en: Limits do not reset per API key. A request occupies a slot until its response completes; excess requests receive HTTP 429.
body.zh: 并发不会因拆分 API Key 而重置。请求从发送到响应结束始终占用槽位，超限返回 HTTP 429。

title.zh: 可以申请扩容，但不是默认保证

body.en: DeepSeek says qualified accounts may request capacity expansion without an extra expansion fee; approval is matched to business need.
body.zh: DeepSeek 表示符合条件的账户可申请扩容，扩容本身不额外收费，但是否批准会结合业务需求。

title.en: Legacy aliases passed their retirement date
title.zh: 旧模型别名已越过退役日期

body.en: The official changelog scheduled deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner for full retirement after 24 July 2026 15:59 UTC. Production integrations should use explicit V4 model IDs rather than treating aliases as durable.
body.zh: 官方变更日志安排 deepseek-chat 与 deepseek-reasoner 在 2026 年 7 月 24 日 15:59 UTC 后完全退役。生产集成应改用明确的 V4 模型 ID，不应再把旧别名视为长期接口。

title.zh: 监控有效任务成本

body.en: The useful dashboard is cache-hit rate, 429 and queue behaviour, expansion availability, completed-task quality and the eventual Flash–Pro price spread—not headline token price alone.
body.zh: 真正有用的监控项是缓存命中率、429 与排队、扩容可得性、任务完成质量，以及最终 Flash—Pro 价差，而不是单看 Token 标价。

fact.en: The current pricing page signals a significant future overall price increase, but publishes no effective date, new rates or cause.
fact.zh: 当前定价页只预告未来将整体显著提价，没有公布生效日、新费率或原因。

hypothesis.en: A link between global usage growth and a future increase is an Afflatus hypothesis to test, not an official explanation. Demand growth and future pricing remain separate variables until DeepSeek discloses causality.
hypothesis.zh: “全球使用量增长导致未来提价”只是 Afflatus 待验证的分析假设，不是官方解释。在 DeepSeek 披露因果之前，需求增长与未来价格必须视为两个独立变量。

method.en: Afflatus operating index: capability 35%, deployment economics 25%, distribution 20%, compute security 10%, weight portability 10%. These are editorial business-system vectors, not benchmark scores. N/A means no comparable, verifiable evidence was available and is never converted to zero.
method.zh: Afflatus 经营指数：能力 35%、部署经济性 25%、分发 20%、算力安全 10%、权重可迁移性 10%。这些是商业系统的编辑向量，不是模型基准分。N/A 表示没有可比、可核验的证据，绝不会被换算成零分。

note.en: Afflatus can observe this identifier in the site runtime, but no public, like-for-like benchmark package was verified. It is registered for operational visibility and excluded from ranking.
note.zh: Afflatus 可在站点运行环境中观察到该标识，但尚未核验到公开且可横向比较的基准包。因此只登记运行状态，不参与排名。

edge.en: Best all-round proprietary frontier and enterprise pull.
edge.zh: 综合闭源前沿与企业需求最强。

risk.en: Open-weight substitution attacks API gross margin and bargaining power.
risk.zh: 开放权重替代直接冲击 API 毛利与议价权。

edge.en: Largest consumer and developer distribution surface.
edge.zh: 消费端与开发者分发面最广。

risk.en: A pro-open-weights signature does not remove a closed-API revenue model.
risk.zh: 支持开放权重的签名并未改变闭源 API 收入模式。

edge.en: Only complete US vertical stack: model, TPU, cloud, search and Android.
edge.zh: 美国唯一完整垂直栈：模型、TPU、云、搜索与 Android。

risk.en: AI answers must grow without destroying search economics.
risk.zh: AI 回答必须增长，同时不能摧毁搜索经济性。

edge.en: Population-scale distribution and incentives aligned with commoditizing models.
edge.zh: 人口级分发，且激励与模型商品化方向一致。

risk.en: Frontier cadence has been less consistent than capex.
risk.zh: 前沿模型发布节奏不及资本开支稳定。

edge.en: Compute concentration plus real-time distribution through X.
edge.zh: 集中算力叠加 X 的实时分发。

risk.en: Governance concentration and volatile product policy.
risk.zh: 治理高度集中，产品政策波动较大。

edge.en: Near-frontier agentic work on the report's cost frontier.
edge.zh: 以成本前沿实现接近前沿的代理任务能力。

risk.en: Capacity shortage, commercial license thresholds and policy exposure.
risk.zh: 容量短缺、商业许可门槛与政策风险。

edge.en: Official Flash API public beta pairs a 1M context with unusually low listed token prices and 2,500 account concurrency.
edge.zh: Flash API 正式版公测以 100 万上下文、极低的当前 Token 标价和每账户 2500 并发组合出击。

risk.en: A significant future price increase is signalled but undefined; effective task cost and capacity behaviour remain the real test.
risk.zh: 官方已预告未来显著提价但方案未定；有效任务成本与容量表现才是真正考验。

edge.zh: 中国最强的模型—云—电商分发闭环。

risk.en: Compute availability limits the pace of global cloud conversion.
risk.zh: 算力可得性限制全球云转化速度。

edge.en: Directly listed frontier exposure and a strong coding lineage.
edge.zh: 可直接交易的前沿模型敞口，编程路线强。

risk.en: K3 exposed scarcity-premium valuation faster than it changed fundamentals.
risk.zh: K3 首先击穿的是稀缺性估值，而非基本面。

edge.en: Listed multimodal lab with consumer-product reach.
edge.zh: 具消费产品触达能力的上市多模态实验室。

risk.en: Model price wars compress a young revenue base before fixed costs mature.
risk.zh: 模型价格战会在固定成本成熟前压缩年轻收入基盘。

title.en: Valuation and macro de-risking came first
title.zh: 首先发生的是估值与宏观去风险

cause.en: AI winners were already under pressure; Korea also faced a rate hike, while oil and bond yields were elevated.
cause.zh: AI 赢家此前已承压；韩国同时遭遇加息，油价与债券收益率也处于高位。

title.zh: K3 成为叙事催化剂

cause.en: The market repriced model pricing power and the return on hyperscaler capex; positioning amplified the move.
cause.zh: 市场重估模型定价权与超大规模资本开支回报；拥挤持仓放大了波动。

title.zh: 中国内部的稀缺性溢价被击穿

cause.en: Directly listed model labs were valued as scarce frontier proxies. K3 raised the capability ceiling without offering a listed Moonshot instrument.
cause.zh: 上市模型实验室此前被当作稀缺前沿代理。K3 抬高能力上限，却没有提供可交易的月之暗面标的。

title.en: The second leg was about cash conversion
title.zh: 第二段下跌转向现金转化问题

cause.en: K3 remained part of the pricing narrative, but capex, free cash flow, memory supply and momentum reversal were independent drivers.
cause.zh: K3 仍是定价叙事的一部分，但资本开支、自由现金流、存储供给与动量反转都是独立驱动。

title.zh: API 价格上限下降

body.en: Closed labs lose the right to price routine agentic work as frontier work.
body.zh: 闭源实验室难以继续把日常代理任务按前沿任务定价。

title.zh: 使用弹性上升

body.en: Lower cost expands token volume, especially for agents. Efficiency lowers unit cost; it does not guarantee lower aggregate compute.
body.zh: 更低成本扩大 Token 用量，代理任务尤其明显。效率降低单位成本，但不保证总算力下降。

title.zh: 资本开支必须证明转化

body.en: Hyperscalers are no longer rewarded for spending alone; investors demand cloud growth, retention and cash conversion.
body.zh: 超大规模厂商不再仅因花钱而获奖赏；投资者要求云增长、留存与现金转化。

title.zh: 稀缺性发生迁移

body.en: Value moves away from raw parameter count toward foundry, memory bandwidth, interconnect, proprietary workflow data and trusted deployment.
body.zh: 价值从参数规模迁移到晶圆、内存带宽、互连、专有工作流数据与可信部署。

title.en: Twenty instruments mapped to five cash-conversion stages
title.zh: 二十只标的映射到五个现金转化环节

body.en: Country remains a risk lens, but the first comparison is now the economic function each company owns. The chain runs from fabrication to compute, memory and interconnect, cloud serving, then model and distribution. This makes duplicate exposure and missing physical chokepoints visible before a ticker is ranked.
body.zh: 国家仍是风险维度，但首要比较标准改为公司真正控制的经济功能。产业链从制造流向算力，再到内存与互连、云服务，最后到模型与分发。这样在标的排序前，就能先看到重复暴露与缺失的物理咽喉。

title.en: Price the layer, not the AI label
title.zh: 按产业层定价，不按 AI 标签定价

body.en: Fair bands use normalized earnings or free cash flow for mature businesses and forward sales only where earnings are not yet meaningful. A stock above the band requires evidence of faster cash conversion; below it may still deserve a discount for policy, dilution or cyclicality.
body.zh: 成熟公司使用正常化盈利或自由现金流，尚无有效盈利的公司才使用远期销售额。高于区间需要更快现金转化作为证据；低于区间也可能因政策、稀释或周期性而理应折价。

thesis.en: K3 changes who buys compute, not who can fabricate leading-edge compute. CoWoS and advanced nodes remain the cleanest toll road.
thesis.zh: K3 改变谁购买算力，却没有改变谁能制造先进算力。CoWoS 与先进制程仍是最干净的收费站。

risk.en: Cross-strait concentration and customer concentration.
risk.zh: 两岸与客户集中风险。

thesis.en: Open models increase the number of inference stacks; custom ASIC and Ethernet monetise diversification away from one accelerator.
thesis.zh: 开放模型增加推理栈数量；定制 ASIC 与以太网从加速器多元化中变现。

risk.en: Programme timing and customer concentration.
risk.zh: 项目节奏与客户集中。

thesis.en: K3 is negative for scarcity pricing but positive for token volume. CUDA, networking and installed capacity keep the platform central.
thesis.zh: K3 不利于稀缺性定价，却有利于 Token 总量。CUDA、网络与装机量仍让平台居于中心。

risk.en: Gross-margin compression and capex digestion.
risk.zh: 毛利压缩与资本开支消化。

thesis.en: The most complete hedge: proprietary frontier, open Gemma, TPU economics, cloud and search distribution.
thesis.zh: 最完整的对冲：闭源前沿、开放 Gemma、TPU 经济性、云与搜索分发。

risk.en: Search cannibalisation and capex-heavy free cash flow.
risk.zh: 搜索自我蚕食与资本开支拖累自由现金流。

thesis.en: Enterprise distribution lets Azure route between closed and open models; the moat is the workflow, not one lab.
thesis.zh: 企业分发让 Azure 可在闭源与开放模型间路由；护城河是工作流，而非某一家实验室。

risk.en: Capex outruns Azure and Copilot monetisation.
risk.zh: 资本开支跑在 Azure 与 Copilot 变现之前。

thesis.en: Open-weight commoditisation supports Meta's strategy: cheaper intelligence feeds engagement and ad conversion at population scale.
thesis.zh: 开放权重商品化符合 Meta 的战略：更便宜的智能在全球规模上提高互动与广告转化。

risk.en: Capex discipline and uneven open-model cadence.
risk.zh: 资本开支纪律与开放模型节奏不稳。

thesis.en: No algorithm removes the need for leading-edge patterning. K3 reinforces sovereignty demand on both sides.
thesis.zh: 没有算法可以取消先进图形化需求。K3 反而强化两侧的自主算力需求。

risk.en: Export policy and lumpy orders.
risk.zh: 出口政策与订单起伏。

thesis.en: Agentic inference turns east-west traffic and cluster utilisation into first-order economics.
thesis.zh: 代理推理让东西向流量与集群利用率成为一阶经济变量。

risk.en: Premium multiple and hyperscaler concentration.
risk.zh: 高估值与超大规模客户集中。

thesis.en: AWS can sell the model choice, Trainium and the infrastructure around Anthropic; open weights widen the catalogue.
thesis.zh: AWS 可同时销售模型选择、Trainium 与 Anthropic 周边基础设施；开放权重扩大目录。

risk.en: Anthropic concentration and retail/cloud capital competition.
risk.zh: Anthropic 集中与零售/云资本竞争。

thesis.en: MoE and million-token agents remain memory hungry, but the stock must be valued on mid-cycle earnings, never peak gross margin.
thesis.zh: MoE 与百万上下文代理仍然吞噬内存，但股票必须按中周期盈利定价，不能按峰值毛利定价。

risk.en: Supply response and violent inventory cycles.
risk.zh: 供给响应与剧烈库存周期。

thesis.en: The strongest Chinese full-stack public instrument and a disclosed Moonshot backer; K3 validates its open-cloud strategy even while it increases competition.
thesis.zh: 中国最强的全栈上市工具，也是月之暗面已披露投资者；K3 加剧竞争，却验证其开放云战略。

risk.en: Cloud capex, policy and portfolio complexity.
risk.zh: 云资本开支、政策与组合复杂性。

thesis.en: WeChat distribution and gaming cash flow make falling model costs an input benefit rather than a pure pricing threat.
thesis.zh: 微信分发与游戏现金流让模型降价成为投入成本利好，而非纯粹定价威胁。

risk.en: Regulation and slower frontier-model mindshare.
risk.zh: 监管与前沿模型声量偏弱。

thesis.en: The purest listed accelerator-substitution instrument; K3 strengthens sovereign-compute demand.
thesis.zh: 最纯粹的上市加速器替代工具；K3 强化自主算力需求。

risk.en: Yield, software ecosystem and valuation already price success.
risk.zh: 良率、软件生态与估值已预支成功。

thesis.en: China's binding compute constraint is fabrication. Every successful open model raises pressure to localise the silicon below it.
thesis.zh: 中国算力的硬约束是制造。每个成功开放模型都会增加底层芯片国产化压力。

risk.en: Tool restrictions, yield and capital intensity.
risk.zh: 设备限制、良率与资本强度。

thesis.en: Open-model economics are most valuable where intelligence ships into phones, cars and home devices.
thesis.zh: 当智能进入手机、汽车与家庭设备时，开放模型经济性最有价值。

risk.en: Hardware cycles and automotive execution.
risk.zh: 硬件周期与汽车执行。

thesis.en: A second domestic compute vector beyond headline accelerators, with server CPU and DCU exposure.
thesis.zh: 除头部加速器外的第二条国产算力向量，同时覆盖服务器 CPU 与 DCU。

risk.en: High multiple, ecosystem dependence and procurement cycles.
risk.zh: 高估值、生态依赖与采购周期。

thesis.en: A low-multiple full-stack option with autonomous-driving deployment, but model mindshare must stabilise.
thesis.zh: 低估值全栈期权，拥有自动驾驶落地，但模型声量必须止跌。

risk.en: Search decline and frontier share loss.
risk.zh: 搜索下滑与前沿份额流失。

thesis.en: Direct frontier exposure remains strategically rare, but K3 proved that rarity cannot justify any multiple.
thesis.zh: 直接前沿敞口仍然稀缺，但 K3 证明稀缺不能为任何估值背书。

risk.en: Cash burn, dilution and rapid benchmark obsolescence.
risk.zh: 现金消耗、稀释与基准快速过时。

thesis.en: Consumer distribution and multimodal products are the defence; a model-only scarcity premium is not.
thesis.zh: 消费分发与多模态产品才是防线；模型稀缺性溢价不是。

risk.en: Price war before operating leverage.
risk.zh: 经营杠杆形成前先遭遇价格战。

thesis.en: A lower-tier cloud can win if open weights reduce model dependence and let it compete on deployment and service.
thesis.zh: 如果开放权重降低模型依赖，二线云可凭部署与服务竞争。

risk.en: Scale, financing and hyperscaler price competition.
risk.zh: 规模、融资与超大规模云价格竞争。

title.zh: 效率不会消灭算力

thesis.en: Cheaper tokens expand agentic workloads. The bearish case is lower price per unit; the bullish case is much higher unit volume.
thesis.zh: 更便宜的 Token 会扩大代理工作负载。空头看到单位价格下降，多头看到单位数量大幅上升。

invalidate.en: Token growth fails to offset price decline for two quarters.
invalidate.zh: 连续两个季度 Token 增长无法抵消价格下降。

title.en: MoE is sparse compute, not small memory
title.zh: MoE 是稀疏计算，不是小内存

thesis.en: K3 activates 104B parameters but stores a 2.8T model. Memory capacity, bandwidth and expert-parallel traffic remain strategic.
thesis.zh: K3 激活 1040 亿参数，却要存放 2.8 万亿参数模型。内存容量、带宽与专家并行流量仍具战略价值。

invalidate.en: Model compression materially reduces fleet memory per useful task.
invalidate.zh: 模型压缩显著降低每项有效任务的集群内存。

title.zh: 纯模型估值时代结束

thesis.en: A benchmark lead can disappear in weeks. Distribution, proprietary data and retained workflow matter more than launch-day rank.
thesis.zh: 基准领先可在数周内消失。分发、专有数据与留存工作流比发布日排名更重要。

invalidate.en: One lab sustains a capability lead and pricing power for four releases.
invalidate.zh: 某实验室连续四次发布都维持能力领先与定价权。

title.zh: 晶圆制造仍是底层宪法

thesis.en: Algorithmic sovereignty without manufacturing sovereignty still rents a foreign physical stack.
thesis.zh: 只有算法自主而没有制造自主，仍然是在租用外国物理栈。

invalidate.en: A domestic alternative closes the yield and throughput gap.
invalidate.zh: 国产替代品弥合良率与吞吐差距。

title.zh: 开放权重创造云多极化

thesis.en: The same model can be served by hyperscalers, neoclouds or sovereign clusters, shifting competition toward reliability and total task cost.
thesis.zh: 同一模型可由超大规模云、新云或主权集群托管，竞争转向可靠性与任务总成本。

invalidate.zh: 监管阻断跨服务商权重可迁移性。

title.zh: 存储必须按中周期估值

thesis.en: HBM scarcity is real, but every memory cycle eventually attracts supply. Contract visibility changes duration, not cyclicality.
thesis.zh: HBM 稀缺真实存在，但每轮存储周期最终都会吸引供给。合约提高可见度，不会消灭周期。

invalidate.en: Supply growth stays below bit-demand growth through 2028.
invalidate.zh: 到 2028 年供给增长持续低于位需求增长。

title.en: China's model winners need global serving
title.zh: 中国模型赢家还需要全球服务

thesis.en: Weights win mindshare; reliable capacity, compliance, billing and support win enterprise revenue.
thesis.zh: 权重赢得声量；可靠容量、合规、计费与支持才能赢得企业收入。

invalidate.en: Policy permanently blocks adoption in major overseas markets.
invalidate.zh: 政策永久阻断其在主要海外市场的采用。

title.zh: 主权就是采购预算

thesis.en: Open weights turn data residency and continuity from legal clauses into infrastructure purchases.
thesis.zh: 开放权重把数据驻留与业务连续性从法律条款变成基础设施采购。

invalidate.en: Closed APIs satisfy sovereign audit and portability requirements.
invalidate.zh: 闭源 API 能满足主权审计与可迁移要求。

title.zh: 杠铃组合胜过中间层

thesis.en: Own physical chokepoints on one side and distribution/workflow on the other; avoid undifferentiated model wrappers and rented capacity.
thesis.zh: 一端持有物理咽喉，另一端持有分发与工作流；避开无差异模型套壳与租赁算力。

invalidate.en: Application middle layers build durable proprietary data moats.
invalidate.zh: 应用中间层建立可持续的专有数据护城河。

title.en: Cash conversion is the new benchmark
title.zh: 现金转化是新基准

thesis.en: The market will increasingly score AI companies on free cash flow per dollar of capex, not parameters, tokens or benchmark Elo.
thesis.zh: 市场会越来越按每美元资本开支产生的自由现金流评价 AI 公司，而不是参数、Token 或基准 Elo。

invalidate.en: Capital markets resume rewarding spend without monetisation.
invalidate.zh: 资本市场重新奖励没有变现的支出。
